name: Jesse Giddings
tagline: Unit stills and behind-the-scenes content for film and television.
description: Jesse Giddings is a unit stills and BTS photographer for film and television, shooting for FOX, The CW, ABC, CBS, NBC, TNT, TBS, truTV and HBO Max.
work_intro: Episodic and feature unit stills, key art and BTS coverage, from Budapest and Prague to Vancouver and Los Angeles.

bts.intro: I spent twelve years on the other side of the camera as a host at MuchMusic and E! News, so I know how to move around talent, publicists and a working set without slowing anyone down. On set I capture the stills, verticals and BTS moments that marketing and social teams actually need, delivered fast and organized for the edit.
recent: Full Bloom · HBO Max · social producer on set, marketing capture, time-lapses
Miracle Workers: Dark Ages and Oregon Trail · TBS · on-set social capture and promo shoots
Animal Kingdom · TNT · BTS and EPK capture
Snowpiercer · TNT · BTS photography and social content
I Am the Night · TNT · BTS for social

network_tests.text: Before a pilot shoots, networks need to see the cast in hair, makeup and wardrobe. I bring a full lighting setup to the stage or backlot, shoot the entire cast, and deliver edited, network-ready images fast. Recent: Single Parents (ABC).

assignment.intro: Alongside production work, I've spent years photographing humanitarian stories, including documenting the refugee crisis across Greece and Serbia for International Medical Corps, and projects in Kenya, India and Bhutan.

about: I'm a photographer and content creator based between Los Angeles and British Columbia. I've shot unit stills, BTS and social content on more than 30 productions for FOX, The CW, ABC, CBS, NBC, TNT, TBS, truTV and HBO Max, from 9-1-1, The Orville and New Girl to All American, The Alienist in Budapest and Snowpiercer in Vancouver. Before that I was a television host and producer, earning three Daytime Emmy nominations with E! News. I'm available for episodic, feature and campaign work in LA, Vancouver and on location.
